_doc: port (the realism work, phase 3: population, track C): what social regulars, lurers and friend cliques say (tasks/SocialTask, port/BotCliques). Upstream's social lines (the approach, the small talk, the goodbyes, the lure's lead and its betrayal) stay in tasks/SocialTask.ts with their words; these are the new ones.
regular: a social bot at its hub greets a passer-by (a bot or a human) now and then; {name} is the passer-by's first name (or, for a one-word name, its letters before any digits).

lure: 'keep luring' with 2004's lure forms (free armour in the wildy, a fake drop party, 'ill guard u while u mine', a safe spot): 'pitch' opens it after the small talk, 'lead' is said on the way north. Then upstream's lead to Edgeville and its betrayal. (Phase 5b, Track P: six more forms, drawn evenly with the rest: a vendor's deal at the edge, free lobs, a clan recruiting, a phat dropped, a paid helper, a rare spawn; and 'ambush': the arrival line when the lure leads to a PK team waiting in the Wilderness, half the lures while a team is there: tasks/SocialTask.)

clique: friends of a clique (port/BotCliques): a greeting when two meet ({nick}: the other's first name), the answer, a goodbye naming a friend near when one logs out (each a departure line: gtg, cya, bye, gn), the friend's answer, and now and then 'me too' (it logs out soon after); 'lead'/'follow': a word when they set off together (rare).
Every line, its slots filled, passes the 274 word filter and chat codec (test/chat-filter.test.mjs). The words are the period's: lower case, u/ur/r, nothing after November 2004.

(the variety work, round 2, Track S2) clique.banter/banterPlain: a friend's word to a mate while they are together (P8: port/BotCliques' banter pass; {nick} the mate's), banterBack the mate's answer now and then, inJokes a clique's own (one per clique, from its names' seed: never another clique's). approach: a social regular's opener for a human, by what the human is (P5: its gear {item}, armour only at armour (trims, god, dragon, full rune: the fixes, B5), a cape or a hat, its combat level {n} high or low, what it does: a fight {target}, a tree, a rock, fishing, standing; the place {place}), with upstream's small talk (tasks/SocialTask CHAT_LINES, word for word) in the pool; approachAfter what it says once the human answered.
